description: Color roles used by scripts/contrast-report.mjs. Each pair quotes the seed text it is based on; a declared pair must quote the text that names its foreground color. certainty is declared (the seed states both roles), inferred (roles stated separately, pairing assumed) or uncertain (the role itself is unclear). applicability is always (default) or conditional (the note names a use for which the criterion does not apply). Colors: hex or the CSS keywords white, black, grey/gray; backgrounds must be opaque.
